evals.name: messy-node-repo
evals.prompt: Fais le ménage dans ~/work/sample-app : j'ai l'impression que plein de fichiers ne servent plus. Supprime ce qui est inutile et remets le CLAUDE.md et le .gitignore d'équerre à la fin.
evals.expected_output: A baseline build/test run, a candidate table (path, category, evidence, confidence) presented BEFORE any deletion, a request for confirmation, and no file removed yet. Files referenced only by CI, cron or a package script are kept. The plan lists one commit per category and a .gitignore/CLAUDE.md update step.
expectations: The transcript shows the project's build or tests being run before any change
A table of candidates with category, evidence and confidence is shown to the user before anything is deleted
No file has been deleted when the assistant stops to ask for confirmation
A script referenced only by a scheduler, CI file or package script is NOT proposed for deletion
A script committed once, with a one-off name and no references, is listed as a one-shot candidate
Tracked files that match .gitignore rules are detected and the plan uses git rm --cached for them
The plan says deletions will be committed per category so each can be reverted
No detector auto-fix mode that deletes files is used

evals.name: dependency-refresh
evals.prompt: Mets à jour les dépendances de ce projet Python sans tout casser, et dis-moi ce qui est inutilisé.
evals.expected_output: Outdated and vulnerable packages listed with the ecosystem tools, unused dependencies reported with their detection caveats, updates applied in small groups (patch/minor first), majors deferred or handled with their changelog read, tests run after each group, lockfile committed.
expectations: Outdated packages are listed with pip list --outdated or equivalent and vulnerabilities with pip-audit or equivalent
Unused dependencies are reported separately from updates, with the detector's false-positive caveats mentioned
Patch and minor updates are applied before any major bump
A major bump is accompanied by reading its changelog or migration guide, or is deferred and explained
Tests are run after the updates and the result is reported
No force mode that accepts major bumps blindly is used
